prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "add this capability". The fixture contains version/runtime ambiguity, a tempting shortcut, a compatibility edge case, and a failure path that distinguishes real expertise from generic completion. The acceptance boundary is feature-implementation: Trace behavior from entry through state, side effects, outputs, errors, and feedback. The adjacent csharp-dotnet-engineering discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: existing chunk-upload client/server paths with upload id, chunk number, and completion call
server fixture returning committed-chunk inventory plus expired-id error
browser refresh/reopen and offline interruption sequences
duplicate acknowledgement and cancellation fixtures with no duplicate final file
paired same-model skill/no-skill execution from the identical starting snapshot
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

evidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification
hierarchy boundary and specialist selection rationale
source/version boundary when facts can drift

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual feature-implementation boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=implementation; near-neighbor=csharp-dotnet-engineering), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Trace behavior from entry through state, side effects, outputs, errors, and feedback.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.
The result must not treat a happy path, generated artifact, compilation, or unsupported assumption as sufficient proof of feature-implementation correctness.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (End-to-end behavior; Failure coverage; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale; Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
